# NDWS Phase 1 results (generated by `python -m src.aml.evaluate`)

All numbers are on the held-out **test** split; thresholds for F1 / precision / recall were chosen on the validation split. PR-AUC 95% CIs come from a patch-level bootstrap (500 resamples). Lift = PR-AUC / test positive rate (chance level = 1x). The spatial test set holds smaller, isolated fires with a lower positive rate than the official test set, so compare protocols with Lift and ROC-AUC, not raw PR-AUC. Do not edit by hand; rerun the script.

## Protocol: `official`

| Model | PR-AUC [95% CI] | Lift | ROC-AUC | F1 | Precision | Recall | Recall@1%FPR | Recall@5%FPR | Brier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| Neighbourhood persistence | 0.173 [0.157, 0.191] | 13.8x | 0.729 | 0.337 | 0.288 | 0.407 | 0.360 | 0.491 | 0.0121 |
| Logistic regression | 0.230 [0.213, 0.249] | 18.4x | 0.903 | 0.327 | 0.246 | 0.488 | 0.363 | 0.665 | 0.0106 |
